brief: @buildthis.bisks.net build a website with unlabeled widgets: levers, rotary dials, switches, sliders, &c producing a deterministic, encoded output. Have a button to send a skeet addressed to you with the encoded output. You would then need to be able to decode the output and build what it specifies
note: built switchboard.bisks.net: unlabeled levers/dials/switches/a slider, deterministic code, TX button skeets it at me — and I taught myself to decode it into a real build next time.
